channel.title: The Points Guy - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Points Guy (thepointsguy.com)

item.title: Airfare impact: Will the Middle East conflict lead to higher flight prices?
item.description: Travelers will hopefully see flight operations return to normal soon, but they may also see higher prices.

item.title: American Express opens a brand-new 'speakeasy-style' lounge: First look inside Sidecar
item.description: American Express has introduced an all-new airport lounge concept called Sidecar. Here's a look inside the first location in Las Vegas.

item.title: I qualified for American Airlines status but don’t see it yet — here’s why you might not either
item.description: Many American Airlines flyers who qualify for status at the last minute via credit card spending typically have to wait a little longer to get the good news about their status.

item.title: The 5 best places to see the 2026 total solar eclipse
item.description: On Aug. 12, 2026, a rare total solar eclipse will travel over Eastern Greenland, Western Iceland, Northern Spain and the Balearic Islands.

item.title: Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card review: A card for all Hilton fans
item.description: The Hilton Amex Aspire offers tons of benefits, from bonus points on Hilton stays to complimentary Diamond status. Here's what you need to know to apply.

item.title: Credit card transfer partners: Guide to transferring points and miles to airlines and hotels
item.description: A look at the airline and hotel loyalty programs that partner with credit card issuers like American Express, Chase, Bilt, Citi, Capital One and Wells Fargo.

item.title: American and United face new challenge in O’Hare turf war: the FAA
item.description: American Airlines and United Airlines will need to prune their schedules at Chicago's O'Hare International Airport following FAA intervention.

item.title: This IHG hotel in Turks & Caicos is now open near a stunning turquoise-water beach
item.description: The Hotel Indigo Turks & Caicos Grace Bay is now open near Grace Bay Beach, and you can book it with IHG One Rewards points.

item.title: Deal alert: Fly to Spain for only 14,000 Chase points
item.description: These deals put a dream trip to Spain within reach for anyone with pretty much any kind of transferable points.

item.title: Why the Delta SkyMiles Reserve card is still one of the best cards in my wallet
item.description: Statement credits and lounge access are just two of the reasons why the Delta SkyMiles Reserve American Express is one of the best cards in my wallet.
